an7.67:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] yato kho bhikkhave, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ sattahi nagaraparikkhārehi suparikkhataṃ hoti, catunnañca āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an7.67:1.2: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ akaraṇīyaṃ bāhirehi paccatthikehi paccāmittehi.
an7.67:2.2: idha bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare esikā hoti gambhīranemā sunikhātā acalā asampavedhī.
an7.67:2.3: iminā paṭhamena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. (2)
an7.67:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare parikhā khatā hoti gambhīrā ceva vitthatā ca.
an7.67:3.2: iminā dutiyena nagara parikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. (3)
an7.67:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare anupariyāya patho hoti ucco ceva vitthato ca.
an7.67:4.2: iminā tatiyena nagara parikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. (4)
an7.67:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ āvudhaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti salākaṃ ceva jevaniyañca.
an7.67:5.2: iminā catutthena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. (5)
an7.67:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahu balakāyo paṭivasati - seyyathīdaṃ:
an7.67:6.2: hatthārohā assārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyikā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā papphālikā. cammayodhino dāsakaputtā.
an7.67:6.3: iminā pañcamena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. (6)
an7.67:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare dovāriko hoti paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā.
an7.67:7.2: iminā chaṭṭhena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. (7)
an7.67:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare pākāro hoti ucco ceva vitthato ca vāsanalepanasampanno ca.
an7.67:8.2: iminā sattamena nagaraparikkhārena suparikkhataṃ hoti rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an7.67:9.1: katamesaṃ catunnaṃ āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī: (1)
an7.67:9.2: idha bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya, bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. (2)
an7.67:10.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ sāliyavakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya. (3)
an7.67:11.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tilamāsamuggāparannaṃ sannicastaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya, bāhirānaṃ paṭighātā ya. (4)
an7.67:12.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ bhesajjaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti seyyathīdaṃ:
an7.67:12.2: sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ loṇaṃ abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya, bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
an7.67:12.3: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, catunnaṃ āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an7.67:13.1: yato kho bhikkhave, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ imehi sattahi nagaraparikkhārehi suparikkhataṃ hoti, imesaṃ catunnaṃ āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an7.67:13.2: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ akaraṇīyaṃ bāhirehi paccatthikehi paccāmittehi.
an7.67:13.3: evameva kho bhikkhave, yato ariyasāvako sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti, catunnañca jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an7.67:13.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akaraṇīyo mārassa akaraṇīyo pāpimato.
an7.67:14.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare esikā hoti gambhīranemā sunikhātā acalā asampavedhī abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:14.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ -
an7.67:14.3: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammā sambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
an7.67:14.4: saddhesiko bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti,
an7.67:15.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare parikhā hoti gambhīrā ceva vitthatā ca abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:15.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako hirimā hoti, hirīyati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
an7.67:15.3: hiriparikho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti,
an7.67:16.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare anupariyāyapatho hoti ucco ceva vitthato ca, abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:16.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako ottappī hoti. ottappati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena, ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā
an7.67:16.3: ottappaparīyāya patho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti,
an7.67:17.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ āvudhaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti, salākaṃ ceva jevaniyañca abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:17.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo, ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhe kalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthā savyañjanā kevalaparipuṇṇā parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
an7.67:17.3: sutāvudho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti,
an7.67:18.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahu balakāyo paṭivasati, seyyathīdaṃ:
an7.67:18.2: hatthārohā assārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyikā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:18.3: evameva kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an7.67:18.4: viriyabalakāyo bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti,
an7.67:19.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare dovāriko hoti paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:19.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā.
an7.67:19.3: sati dovāriko bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti,
an7.67:20.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare pākāro hoti ucco ceva vitthato ca vāsanalepanasampanno ca abbhantarānaṃ guttiyā bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:20.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
an7.67:20.3: paññāvāsanalepanasampanno bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti,
an7.67:21.1: katamesaṃ catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī: (1)
an7.67:21.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:21.3: evameva kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako, vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an7.67:21.4: attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya, okkamanāya nibbānassa. (2)
an7.67:22.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ sāliyavakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya, bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:22.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an7.67:22.3: attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya, okkamanāya nibbānassa. (3)
an7.67:23.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tilamuggamāsāparannaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:23.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako pītiyāca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati, sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyaṃjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an7.67:23.3: attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya, okkamanāya nibbānassa. (4)
an7.67:24.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ bhesajjaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti seyyathīdaṃ:
an7.67:24.2: sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ loṇaṃ abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya,
an7.67:24.3: evameva kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an7.67:24.4: attano ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya, okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an7.67:24.5: imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an7.67:25.1: yato ca kho bhikkhave, ariyasāvako imehi sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti, imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an7.67:25.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akaraṇīyo mārassa akaraṇīyo pāpimatoti.
